The independent exact 1024-subforest certificate confirms both equal Laplacian characteristic polynomials with coefficients (1,-20,169,-788,2223,-3916,4295,-2838,1051,-188,11,0). Independently enumerated matchings give (1,10,34,46,23,2) versus (1,10,34,46,23,3). Every proper coloring of a complement of a tree partitions into disjoint tree edges and singletons; thus chi(G_B;q)-chi(G_A;q)=(q)_6 and six-label coloring counts differ 2160−1440=720. The two concrete finite instances are completely checked, with no minimum-size claim.

originality.rationale: Rejected as a mechanically implied special case of PRIOR published results: pre-2026 graph-spectral enumerations document the existence of Laplacian-cospectral trees with different adjacency spectra (the 2008 graph-spectra study reports Laplacian collisions at 11 vertices not all also adjacency-cospectral). For trees the adjacency characteristic polynomial IS their matching polynomial (classical), and the complement chromatic polynomial is the falling-factorial transform of matching numbers (elementary). Zheng 2026 Theorem for graph Morse ensembles says their full ensemble polynomial is determined exactly by the Laplacian spectrum. Combining these already published claims yields the existence of equal independence Morse ensemble but unequal complement chromatic polynomial by simply taking complements. The newly displayed specific pair, polynomial and 720 six-coloring difference instantiate rather than strengthen that known implication. This is claim-level covering implication, even without earlier authors using the new 2026 vocabulary. The older enumeration was inspected at table level rather than exact graph pair; no assertion the exact labeled edge sets occur there.

value.rationale: The chromatic-recovery question is natural and newly formulated, but its negative existence answer in this form is a routine transformation of already known Laplacian/non-adjacency-cospectral tree pairs using Zheng’s explicit determinant theorem and classical matching-coloring identities. The result supplies no smallest-order obstruction, new family, independent structural mechanism or classification; its exact 11-vertex arithmetic is a recomputation/witness to the mechanically implied existence. Correctness and reproducibility do not independently make this already implied observation valuable under the specified bar.
